notes: «قالا حدثنا ثم، ذكر كلمة معناها شعبة» : the written word «ثم» is garbled; the gloss says the word stands for Shu'ba, and Shu'ba is read here as the link (the same name is written in the next words)
«يحيى، ومحمد، قالا» : two co-transmitters at one level; the second محمد is the second occurrence of the word
The Prophet is the end; Ibn Umar is the last link

fixes.reason: The name at this level is written as «ثم» with a gloss that says the word means Shu'ba; the reading uses Shu'ba, which the text gives in the gloss.
